title: Entity Find
text: Find entities, 1 input, 7 outputs, {Event actions} sets the event action; {Resource} sets the name of the reference resource the entities use, {Extract found entities} sets the extract and reroute found entities, {Additional filtering condition} adds optional filtering condition, {Matching condition} defines the matching condition match =, {Number of entities found, f} sets the outputs the number of entities that are, {Number of entities departed, d} sets the outputs the number of entities that have departed, {Number of found entities in block, n} sets the outputs the number of found entities that are yet, {Average wait, w} sets the outputs the average wait time, {Average queue length, l} sets the outputs the average length of the entity and {Number of entities extracted, ex} sets the number of entities extracted from this. Values come from the instance.
